articles.title: An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking gang
articles.content: Google’s threat intelligence group said it had a mole inside TeamPCP's inner circle.

articles.title: LLMs respond differently to harmful prompts when AI watermarking is used
articles.content: SynthID can cause models to follow harmful instructions they would otherwise refuse.
articles.contentZh: SynthID可能会导致模型遵循否则会拒绝的有害指令。

articles.title: Nonprofit that tracks meteors taken down by "critical blow" from a cyberattack
articles.content: Group plans to be largely out of commission for several weeks.

articles.title: Amazon wants to help the Colorado River, but we still don’t know how much water the company uses
articles.content: Amazon plans to spend $20 million on water conservation projects along the Colorado River, a crucial but dwindling water supply for 40 million people in the Western US.
